name: infinito-memory
description: Your INFINITO vault on this computer: secrets in a KeePass file that Claude never sees. Your memory comes from your INFINITO account.
long_description: INFINITO keeps one memory for all your AIs in your INFINITO account: connect Claude to https://infinitomemory.com/mcp as a custom connector and it uses the same memory as ChatGPT, Claude Code and your other apps. Secrets never go in that memory. This extension keeps them on your computer instead, in a KeePass file encrypted with your master password, which also opens with KeePassXC or KeePassDX. Claude only ever sees the names of your entries: saving or showing a secret opens a small window on your screen where you type or read it, so the master password and the values never pass through Claude or the chat. The extension keeps no memory of its own and sends nothing anywhere.

tools.name: vault_unlock
tools.description: Open your vault: you type the master password in a window on your screen.

tools.name: vault_add
tools.description: Keep a new secret: you type it in a window on your screen.

tools.name: vault_reveal
tools.description: Show you a secret in a window on your screen; Claude never sees it.

tools.name: vault_list
tools.description: The names of your secrets, never their values.

tools.name: vault_status
tools.description: Whether your vault is locked or open.

vault_folder.title: Vault folder
vault_folder.description: Where INFINITO keeps your vault file, boveda.kdbx. Keep the default to share it with Claude Code and the other apps on this computer.
